newsitem.title: USA: PageNet to launch VoiceNow broadly in Q1.
newsitem.headline: PageNet to launch VoiceNow broadly in Q1.

text.p: Paging Network Inc (PageNet) said on Thursday that its San Francisco and Dallas/Fort Worth trials of voice paging service VoiceNow are going well and predicted a major launch of the product in first quarter 1997.

"We expect to have several hundred units (VoiceNow pagers) being utilized by selected commercial customers by year end and a major launch of the product in the first quarter of 1997," PageNet chief executive Glenn Marschel said.
PageNet, reporting third quarter results, said domestic pagers in use rose to 8.4 million, 36.8 percent up from a year earlier.
PageNet reported a $0.21 loss per share per quarter, deeper into the red than the $0.12 analysts' consensus loss on First Call. The year-ago loss was $0.10.

However, paging companies are generally loss-making, with analysts concentrating instead on their operating cash flow to measure their performance. PageNet operating cashflow rose 24.9 percent to $65 million from $54 million a year ago.
"We're very pleased with PageNet's strong performance and growth during the quarter," Marschel said. "We continue to expand our market share in the traditional paging arena," he added.
The stock jumped 1-1/4, or eight percent, to 17-1/8 by 1130 EDT/1530 GMT. -- Nick Louth, New York Newsroom 212 859 1712
